usageNotes: Use this to monitor all automated bare-metal installations managed by proxmox-auto-installer instances connected to PDM. Each record shows the current lifecycle status ('in-progress', 'answer-sent', 'no-answer-found', 'finished') and includes rich post-hook hardware/network data once the installation completes. Requires the 'System.Audit' privilege on the '/system/auto-installation' path; the post-hook-token field is scrubbed from all API responses and never returned.

examples.summary: List all automated installations to check for any stuck or unanswered installs

tips: Filter client-side on 'status' field: 'no-answer-found' means no matching answer file was located for the machine — check answer templates and hardware identifiers.
The 'uuid' field uniquely identifies each installation session; correlate it with auto-installer logs or answer files when troubleshooting.
Post-hook data (SSH host keys, FQDN, disk layout, machine-id) is only populated after a successful installation completes and the post-install webhook fires.
The 'received-at' field is a Unix epoch integer — convert to human-readable time when triaging stalled installs.
The 'post-hook-token' is intentionally omitted from all API responses; it exists only on disk for webhook authentication.
